core_question: Can we re-enable the original pymer4 Lmer fit in the base conda env so R2-6 reading-time LMM and R2-8 error-type GLMM can be refit with Satterthwaite df and crossed random effects identical to the manuscript pipeline?
knowns: base env has pymer4 0.x, rpy2, and R 4.x installed at /Users/junlee/miniconda3/lib/R
base env numpy is at 2.2.6 but matplotlib 3.6.2 and Bottleneck 1.3.7 compiled against numpy 1.x ABI, so their import fails with 'numpy.core.multiarray failed to import'
pymer4 imports matplotlib transitively, so matplotlib import failure blocks Lmer instantiation even though rpy2 itself may be fine
huggingface_env has clean numpy 2 plus matplotlib stack but no pymer4 or rpy2 installed
manuscript-pipeline reading-time LMM formula is log_time ~ disagree * reliability * group + pgy_within_5 + (1|reader) + (1|filename), crossed random effects fit with REML via lmerTest through pymer4
unknowns: If a test harness runs python -c from pymer4 models import Lmer print ok after the pip upgrade and the process returns non-zero exit code or stderr shows ImportError, the upgrade failed to restore pymer4 and fallback to statsmodels is required

If after the pip upgrade Lmer fit on the 1,400-row REML spec throws an rpy2 TypeError or crashes within 60 seconds, the rpy2 numpy2ri C-binding is broken by the numpy ABI shift and statsmodels fallback is required
assumptions: matplotlib >= 3.9 and Bottleneck >= 1.4 PyPI wheels ship with numpy 2 ABI bindings, so pip upgrade restores _ARRAY_API
rpy2 compiled against R 4.x in /Users/junlee/miniconda3/lib/R does not link to matplotlib or Bottleneck, so upgrading those leaves the rpy2 numpy2ri binding intact
no other base-env package pins matplotlib<3.8 as a hard constraint that pip upgrade would refuse
disconfirmation: If python -c import matplotlib bottleneck from pymer4 models import Lmer print ok exits non-zero after the upgrade, or if a Lmer fit smoke test throws rpy2 RRuntimeError within 60 seconds, abandon the pymer4 fix and fall back to statsmodels MixedLM for both R2-6 and R2-8.

verification_trace.command: conda run -n base python -c "import matplotlib, bottleneck; from pymer4.models import Lmer; print('ok')"
